Food Assistance in Moreno Valley

If you need food assistance, here are resources in Moreno Valley. Food help is provided every day in our community by faith-based and non‑profit organizations. We want to help residents locate the support these organizations provide.

Find a Pantry Near You

To find a food pantry near you — along with hours of operation and any restrictions or requirements — use the interactive Moreno Valley Food Pantry Map below, or call 951.413.3109 for help.

Service hours are subject to change. Please contact the food pantry directly to verify days and times.
Moreno Valley Food Pantries

Food Pantry List

The pantries below serve residents across Moreno Valley. Tap an address for directions or a phone number to call. Updated 7/20/2026 — service hours are subject to change, so please contact the pantry directly to confirm days and times.

  • Al Rahma Food Bank

    • 12125 Day Street, Suite T102, Moreno Valley, CA 92557
    • (951) 378-3033
    • Every Friday, 2:00 PM - 5:00 PM

  • Building Up Lives Foundation – Emergency Food Pantry Booth

    • 22616 Alessandro Blvd., Moreno Valley, CA 92553 - Located at the Veterans of Foreign Wars (VFW) building.
    • (951) 550-5466
    • Every Sunday, 1:00 PM – 3:00 PM – Walk-up food distribution
    • *Every Tuesday and Thursday for homebound or mobility-challenged residents. Must text in advance to schedule assistance.

    • 21866 Brill Rd, Moreno Valley, CA 92553
    • (951) 237-8143
    • Every Thursday, 8: 00 AM - 12:00 PM

    • Moreno Valley, CA (call for location)
    • (951) 247-2273
    • Every Thursday, 9:00 AM - 10:30 AM

  • Oasis Food Alliance Pantry

    • 23750 Alessandro Ave STE C, Moreno Valley, CA 92557
    • (951) 653-0737
    • Every Saturday, 7:00 AM - 9:00 AM

  • Salvation Army – Moreno Valley

    • 13300 Indian St., Moreno Valley, CA 92553
    • (951) 784-4490
    • Every Wednesday, 8:00 AM - 11:00 AM

  • Breakthrough CDC

    • 14161 Elsworth Street Unit C, Moreno Valley, CA 92553
    • (951) 656-3407
    • Every Thursday, 11:00 AM - 1:00 PM

  • Church of Christ Moreno Valley

    • 12660 Indian St, Moreno Valley, CA 92553

  • Crossword Christian Church

    • 21401 Box Springs Road, Moreno Valley, CA 92557

  • Generations Church (Immanuel House)

    • 12125 Day St Ste A203, Moreno Valley, CA 92557

  • Feeding America

    • Moreno Valley Conference & Recreation Center
    • Distribution takes place the 2nd Thursday of the month from 9 AM - 11 AM
